title: Desktop host and update profiles
summary: Original bounded desktop interaction in Electron, Tauri, Wails and Avalonia, with narrow IPC validation and explicit local Windows Velopack packaging and user-controlled updates.

profiles: Linux x86_64, Node 24.19.0: 2 IPC frame/input boundary tests passed. No Electron GUI process was launched.
Linux x86_64, Go 1.27.2: go test app.go app_test.go passed for the original Wails method. No Wails GUI build was run.
notes: Electron GUI, Tauri/Wails builds, .NET/Avalonia execution, Windows packaging and real update round trips are unexecuted. OS WebView/GUI/build prerequisites are not present here.
Electron binary installation is deliberate and separate from npm ci --ignore-scripts. Never infer sandbox/GUI validation from the extracted Node unit tests.

Native command and update feed configuration must be reviewed in the receiving app. Velopack profile produces local Windows artifacts only and requires explicit user restart; signing/publishing and installed-VM update acceptance are separate gates.
All Wails frontend/dist files are original static source. No third-party generated runtime, binary or installer is included.
